## Hinge · One parameter, every component {#fv4-hinge .fv-lesson .relation-lesson }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices"><div class="hinge-question relation-hinge-question"><p>Which point lies on</p><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\underset{\sim}{r}=\begin{bmatrix}1\\-2\\3\end{bmatrix}+\lambda\begin{bmatrix}2\\1\\-1\end{bmatrix}?"></span></div></div><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span><span data-math="(5,0,2)"></span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span><span data-math="(4,2,-2)"></span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span><span data-math="(5,0,1)"></span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span><span data-math="(3,-1,4)"></span></span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. The same value works in every component.</div></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Additional diagnostic question</div>

::: {.notes}
Correct choice 3: λ=2 gives (5,0,1). Distractor 1 matches x and y at λ=2 but has the wrong z coordinate; it represents checking only two components. Distractor 2 is twice the direction vector, omitting the fixed position vector. Distractor 4 uses λ=1 but adds rather than subtracts λ in the z component. Ready: proceed to coordinate planes. Divided: pairs identify the parameter implied by each coordinate, explain inconsistencies and revote. Needs explanation: substitute one shared parameter value into all three equations together, then recheck. All students respond simultaneously with 1–4 fingers on the teacher’s “show” cue. Default 60 seconds; adjustable duration, Start/Pause/Resume and Reset use the shared component. Expiry must not reveal the answer.
:::
